newsitem.title: UK: Courtaulds Text sets 30-35 mln stg review.
newsitem.headline: Courtaulds Text sets 30-35 mln stg review.

text.p: Clothing group Courtaulds Textiles Plc detailed sweeping reorganisation plans on Tuesday aimed at turning round the loss-making group.
The company said it has embarked on a sale of non-strategic and loss-making businesses, and reorganisation would cost it between 30 and 35 million pounds during 1996 and 1997.
The company, which announced a first half pretax loss of 8.5 million pounds compared with a profit of 6.4 million a year before, said the interim results included a charge of 9.1 million pounds.
It forecasts annual savings of 10 to 13 million stg by 1998.
